description: This file defines a generic interface named 'Revision' which serves as the base type for all revision objects within the project. It includes method signatures for comparison, increment, and string conversion operations related to revisions.

classes.name: Revision
classes.description: A generic interface representing a revision with comparison and increment capabilities, parameterized by its own type.

methods.name: isGreaterThan
methods.description: Determines if this revision is greater than another revision.

methods.name: isGreaterThanOrEqualTo
methods.description: Determines if this revision is greater than or equal to another revision.

methods.name: isLowerThan
methods.description: Determines if this revision is lower than another revision.

methods.name: isLowerThanOrEqualTo
methods.description: Determines if this revision is lower than or equal to another revision.

methods.name: increment
methods.description: Creates a new revision by incrementing this revision by one.

methods.name: toLong
methods.description: Returns the revision as a long value.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the revision as a string.
